verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own marketing says admins can vary vesting schedules by group or create custom vesting (ledgy-docs-11). Its financial reports provide tranche-level detail (ledgy-docs-13), which suggests vesting tranches are tracked, but the evidence is thin and only marketing-level. Missing for 10: explicit cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, acceleration on exit (single/double trigger), documented automatic vested-vs-unvested tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
